title: Principal Solutions Architect
description:
Dell is seeking a Principal Solutions Architect who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Principal Solutions Architect, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our tech capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute tech initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 2+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in JavaScript, Team Management, REST APIs, CI/CD
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: AFN 3,800,000 – AFN 6,500,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Staff Risk Analyst
description:

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Staff Risk Analyst with strong expertise in data. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

- Collaborate with team members across departments

- Professional development opportunities

- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays

- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Principal Database Administrator
description:
Join uchealth as a Principal Database Administrator and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Principal Database Administrator with strong expertise in tech. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

- Plan, prioritize, and execute tech projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Automox is seeking a Senior Backend Developer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Senior Backend Developer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our tech capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute tech initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 5+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Analytical Thinking, TypeScript, AWS, Git
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: AFN 3,800,000 – AFN 6,500,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours
